title: A 4224 by 2816 file on XAVC HS 4K and XAVC S 4K at 23.98p and 25p: encoder request, two encoder cores, the 4K memory blocks in an order that holds the picture, descriptors, profiles and the monitoring label
goes_with: dmmwb_zv_v1 (raw write buffer), dmm7slot_zv_v1 (output planes), ogh2816_zv_v1 (first stage 2832 rows passed one to one, sampling ratio 27/32) and outsz4224_zv_v1 (output size), all in coprocessor RAM
encoder_cores: both (UseCore 2), as every stock descriptor above 249 million pixels a second
while_applied: the formats' other frame rates find no descriptor: their recordings are refused at encoder open
the container and the metadata still say 3840 by 2160
the bit rate is the one the menu's record setting says
